hints.title: Group by Artist
hints.text: Aggregate over the artist column to compute total song appearances.

hints.title: Count Occurrences
hints.text: Count the number of rows for each artist and alias the result as occurrences.

hints.title: Two-Tier Sorting
hints.text: Order the aggregated results by occurrences in descending order, then by artist name in ascending order.

hints.title: Artist Frequency Query Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    artist,
    COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM Spotify
GROUP BY artist
ORDER BY occurrences DESC, artist ASC;
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) sorting grouped counts
variables: N: number of Spotify ranking entries
complexity.notes: Grouping by artist followed by multi-column sort.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries per row cause quadratic execution time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregates occurrences correctly and applies multi-column order criteria.
